outcome.technical: DEVIATION FROM THE TASK TEXT, measured: the per-file _module_facts result is NOT memoized. Measured once on this repo (360 py sources, scratch script): ast.parse 4.0-4.5 s, _refs 1.9 s, _module_facts 3.0-3.5 s, runner_walks over 165 runners only 0.3-0.6 s. Full-fidelity JSON of the module facts after pruning calls to the ones _callee could answer was 35 MB and decoded in 3.35 s (pickle: 93 MB, 1.7 s load) - about the cost of building them, so no win. Instead (all in _affected_tests.py): (1) per-file entry {ok, refs} kept under (path, sha256 of text, digest of this module's bytes + interpreter major.minor) - saves the parse and _refs for unchanged files; (2) a runner's WALK result kept with every module (path, content sha) and every import stem the reading touched (via _Tracked lookups), valid only while all still read the same - saves module-facts building; each runner is read over its own names/summaries caches so the touched set is complete (cold result identical to the old shared-cache result on the real tree, see below). Persistence: gather_facts now fills facts['pyReading'] via read_python()/read_facts()/write_facts() in <common git dir>/audit-selection/reading-<digest>.facts (suffix .facts so SELECTION_KEEP's .json bound is untouched; FACTS_KEEP=3 files, entries bounded to current-tree size on merge). select() stays pure: it takes facts['pyReading'] only when its per-file sha map equals _shas(pySources) (_reading_of), else measures cold through the same read_python. _python_arm gained refs=; _walk_arm now takes (suites, runners, walks, gone); _walk_index/runner_walks/_parsed unchanged for existing callers. Whole-answer key (run-test-gate selection_key) untouched. After implementation 86/86 (sweep: '1/1 files ok, 86 cases'). Mutations on the implementation (each run in the shared tree and restored from a backup, cmp same): key without sha -> afm2, afm8 red; runner entry recording only its own module -> afm4 red; walk entry validity ignoring dep shas -> afm4 red; reading used without the sha check -> afm9 red; stems not recorded -> survived the first 9 cases, so afm10 (a new file makes a stem ambiguous) was added and then goes red (afm10).
